title: metadata-protocol: a bare save of a name only a DISABLED package holds silently edits that package's row (200) while the bare read answers 404 — refuse with the ?package= remedy (ruled A)
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUcj2x2Wr4UErwBi12

Filing gate ③, a recorded maintainer ruling. Filed by area S5 (E1b), lease E1, as the home of the ruling below. Source: dev report 6896224874 on #32605 (open_questions), decision batch 2026-11-15 (b).

## 维护者速读

- 问题：一个名字只被停用的包 D 持有（只有 D 的存储行，没有启用中的持有者）。不带包名读取返回 404，但不带包名保存会悄悄改写 D 的行并返回 200。
- 裁决：A，拒绝保存并提示指定包。
- 修法：不带包名保存这种名字时，拒绝并提示用 `?package=` 指定包，不点名任何包，和读取一致。这是声明过的收窄。
- 优先级 p2，本区（S5）处理。

## Ruling

Ruled: option A · the maintainer (Steedos) tapped the decision card at 2026-11-15T21:53Z, relayed by the server#5 seat thread. Question, verbatim: 「决定只被停用包占用的名字在不带包名保存时如何处理」. Chosen option, verbatim: 「拒绝保存并提示指定包」.

As it binds this card (seat's reading of the card): refuse with the existing 409 refusal shape (no new refusal code) and point the caller to the package parameter (`?package=`). The 200 becomes a refusal, so it is a declared narrowing.

## Measured (dev report 6896224874 on #32605)

A name held only by a disabled package D (D's stored row alone, no enabled holder): the bare read (`GET /meta/TYPE/NAME`, no `?package=`) answers 404 (ADR-0150 D3: a disabled package holds no name), but the bare save resolves to D and, when D is writable, updates D's row (200). PR #33889 pins today's 200 as a CONTROL in `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`; this card flips that pin.

## Acceptance

1. A bare publish-mode save of a name only disabled packages hold refuses with the existing 409 refusal shape and the `?package=` remedy, naming no package, in both registration orders, with D's row untouched. CONTROLs: one enabled holder (unchanged), the environment's own item (unchanged), `?package=D` (unchanged).
2. Measure the draft-mode bare save and the bare DELETE for the same state; align them in the same PR or name them in the changeset.
3. Declaration: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `!` title, BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 marker, dogfood battery; the #33889 CONTROL pin flipped and ablated.

## Reader

`domain:server` area S5 (E1b). Same door (`protocol-save.ts`, `servedPackagelessSaveAddress`) and refusal shape as #33955 (two enabled holders): fold candidate if the five fold gates pass. #32780 (in flight) also edits protocol-save.ts: git merge-tree before claim and push.

Prior rulings read: this ruling; ruling 6781691009 on #31527 (D3/D5 symmetry; did not cover this state); ADR-0150 D3 and red line 2; PR #33889's CONTROL pin (the opposite answer, flipped here).

Dedupe: #32605 (closed, the disabled holder beside an enabled one), #33955 (two enabled holders): neither covers the disabled-only state.
